Independent ceiling-187 search, with no suffix, rediscovered a valid 187 completion: first F3 at 26.6s, first F4 at 74.3s, F8/solved at 77.0s. Exact known-route identities were hit at F3-F8. v0.92 ceiling-186 stalled at F3 g156/f183 because the winning basin is a one-point proof corridor. The evaluator is calibrated. Recognition is fast once the ceiling is correct (~75s to terminal), but that cost is still too high to spend on every candidate.
